description: Parkings Aeroport Paris-Beauvais is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Aeroport Paris-Beauvais  // BELLOVA S.A.S. The car parks at Beauvais Airport have a capacity of 4,500 spaces. Our guarded car parks guarantee you a parking in complete serenity. Acclaimed by our users, the Paris-Beauvais Airport car parks are the most convenient way to park your car safely during your trip. Coverage: Aeroport Paris-Beauvais  // BELLOVA S.A.S. The publisher named on the listing is Aeroport Paris-Beauvais  // BELLOVA S.A.S. Its keywords include aeroport, aeroport-paris-beauvais, parking-p2, parking-p1, aeroport-beauvais, parking. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
